༄༅/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'bar ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'bar ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ra we/ thugs rje chen pos 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gang gis dran pa tsam la'ang dngos grub mchog /stsol mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs pad la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal legs par bca'/ /dang por maṇ+ḍal mchod pa/ dung chos gnyis rnams 'dus byas te/ thun mong spyi'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga bya ste/ yo byad spyi la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ/ lan bdun/ dung chos la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+re t+ke hūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ kha bkru/ oṃ khaḥswāhā/ gdong bkru/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ swāhā/ lus thams cad bkru'o/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ā sa ni hūṃ/ gdan la reg oṃ sar+b+ba pā pa na/ ba na ye hūṃ phaṭa/ sna g.yon nas bus/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba bigh+na bh+yaḥ oṃ āḥbadz+ro da ke hūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum maṇ+ḍal chus byugs/ oṃ badz+ra go ma ye swāhā/ lan gsum byug tshul bya/ na mo bha ga ba te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya a ra ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe mahā puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe puṣ+pod+bha we puṣ+pe saṃ bha we puṣ+pe kir+ṇ+ṇe swāhā/ me tog la reg oṃ badz+ra satwā sar+b+ba bigh+nā nu ta sā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ maṇ+ḍal lag pas mnan/ oṃ badz+ra re khe su re khe hūṃ/ mtha' skor ro/ /ba yi gci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /yang dag byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /srog chags legs par bsal ba bzod pa dang*/ / bya ba nye bar gnas pa brtson 'grus so/

/sems rtse gcig de'i skad cig bsam gtan no/ /ri mo legs par 'bar ba shes rab nyid/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs par byas na ni/ /pha rol phyin drug de rnams thob par 'gyur/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las cher lhag cing*/ /zla ba 'dra ba'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid/ /oṃ su re khe （《dzaṃ》+ badz+ra le kha a dh+ri tiṣ+ṭhan+tu ） sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swāhā/ oṃ waḥswāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+rār+k+ka bi ma le swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍ-i ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sar+b+ba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bā na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+ri bha ba mahā sa ma ya satwa aḥ （《dzaṃ》+ badz+ra la khe adhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ ） oṃ haṃ su me ru ma dh+yam na maḥ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ yaṃ bi de ha dwi pa ya na maḥ shar lus 'phags po/ raṃ dzam+bu dwi pa ya na maḥ lho dzam+bu gling*/ lāṃ （《dzaṃ》+ a pa ra ） go da nī dī pa ya na maḥ nub ba glang spyod/ waṃ ku ru dwi ba ya na maḥ byang sgra mi snyan/ ya u pa dwi pa ya na maḥ yā u pa dwi pa ya na maḥ shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ ra u pa dwi pa ya na maḥ rā u pa dwi pa ya na maḥ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ la u pa= lā u pa= nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ wa u pa= wā u pa= byang du sgra mi snyan dang*/ sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ yā glang po rin po che na maḥ rā khyim bdag rin po che na maḥ lā rta mchog rin po che na maḥ wā bud med rin po che na maḥ yaḥral gri rin po che na maḥ raḥnor bu rin po che na maḥ laḥ'akhor lo rin po che na maḥ wāḥgater chen rin po che na maḥ

oṃ aṃ zla ba/ oṃ a nyi ma*/ oṃ oṃ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhing dang 'byor pa ma tshang ba med pa kun tu bzang pos byas pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bo nyid na ma rin chen sna tshogs rang bzhin nyid/ /ri rab lcog brgyad nye bar mdzes/ /gling bzhi gling phran ldan pa 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ā tsar+ya bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ badz+ra kro dha rā dze bh+yaḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ badz+ra ka ma la bh+yaḥ tiṣ+ṭhan+tu ā sa naṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ gu ru badz+ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na sam+bha ba hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a mṛ ta bha ba hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbai ro tsa na hūṃ/ oṃ ā sa ma ya tā ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbud+dha lo tsa na hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmā ma ki hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbaṇ+ḍa rā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dha twī shwa ri hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpra dzñan+ta kri ta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kri ta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ba ghin+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ khaṃ hrīḥskaṃ saṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ khyod la phyag 'tshal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed la phyag 'tshal khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag ni gus pas khyed la phyag 'tshal gyi/ /bla ma mgon pos bdag la thugs rjes gzung*/ / byis pa rmongs pa dag gis ni/ /gang yang rang bzhin sdig pa dang*/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho nyid/ /sdig pa cung zad gang bsags pa/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar gnas bcas te/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang du yang du phyag byas nas/ /nongs pa de dag bshags par bgyi/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ / skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rje la phyag 'tshal lo/

/phyag 'os sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnams dang*/ /tshul khrims bzang ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtshan nyid dang*/ rang bzhin gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sbyin pa dang sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /'di la bdag gis nyi ma'i snang ba dang*/ /mun pa ji lta de bzhin nyid du ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi sdug bsngal gzhil ba dang*/ /bde ba spel ba yang ni dus mnyam gyur/ / mthong thos rjes su dran dang 'ong ba dang*/ /reg dang gtam gyi sbyor ba nyer thob pa/ /rnam pa kun gyi 'gro la phan byed du/ /rtag par phan dang bde ba rnams bgyi'o/ /oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal a dhi pa ti badz+ra ā tsar+ya gu ru tsa ra ṇā ya badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tā+-its+tsha na maḥ lan bdun/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥhūṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ lan gcig /de bzhin tu rat+na saṃ bha ba= a mṛ ta bha ba/ bai ro tsa na （《dzaṃ》+ hūt/ oṃ āḥs ma ya tā ra hūt/ oṃ āḥbud+dha ） lo tsa na/ mā ma ki /baṇ+ḍa rī= badz+ra dha twi shwa ri= yamān+ta kṛta= pradzñā n+ta kṛta= pad+mān+ta kṛta= bi gha nan ta kṛta= rnams la'ang sbyar/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ khaṃ hrīḥska saṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du/

badz+ra pu ṣ+pe 'i gnas su badz+ra dhu paṃ dang*/ badz+ra dī paṃ dang badz+ra gan+dhe dang*/ badz+ra nai wi te dang*/ badz+ra ak+ṣa ta/ badz+ra ba sa na rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang bcas te/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ rgyas par na/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i bstod pa logs su yod pa ltar yang bya mod kyi/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro sogs kyi skabs/ de tsam gyis chog go / bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa stsal tu gsol/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang*/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa'i/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs/ / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥgats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā ba naṃ/ gang zhig kun tu rtog pa bcom pa chos kyi skur brjod dang*/ /dpe med bde ba'i cha yis mdzes pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /srid na phan pa mdzad phyir sprul pa yi ni sku gang yin/ / bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' des ni khyed la bde legs mdzod/ /de dag ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi maṇ+ḍal te sngon du bya ba'o/ /sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs 'di nges par mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len la ma 'grub kyang mngon rtogs kyi cho ga'i yan lag chad par mi 'gyur ro/ / de nas sgrub thabs dngos la 'jug ste/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad dga.oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/

ces man+ḍal bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan brtsegs par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma tsan+ḍa arka bi ma le swā hā/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dbus nas brtsams te lha rnams la g.yas skor gyis mchod pa phul bar bsam nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ oṃ las byung ba'i me tog 'bul bzhin du / na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ budhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe mahā puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pa ud+bha be puṣ+pe （《dzaṃ》+ saṃ bha we puṣ+pa a pa ） ki ra ṇe swāhā/ zhes pa bzla bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ / zhes sems bskyed la/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim/ tshad med bzhi yun ring du bsgom/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid kyang thugs ka'i tāṃ la thim/ snang ba tsam gyi rnam shes ni/ /sems tsam du ni rnam par brtag /nam mkha' rdo rjer gnas sems 'di/ /chos can med cing chos nyid med/ /sa bon de nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang sems sgrol ma skyabs sbyin dang ut+pal 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas nam mkhar bzhag la （《dzaṃ》+ gnas par gyur/ ） rang sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i yaṃ raṃ waṃ laṃ suṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab skad cig gis grub pa ni/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su zla gam gyi rnam pa ba dan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ri bdun dang rol pa'i mtsho bdun dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po gling bcu gnyis dang bcas pa rnams khor yug gi ri bos yongs su bskor ba/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyis nye bar brten pa'o/ /ri rab kyi rtse mor pad nyi la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ byang ser/ nub dmar/ lho sngo/ lte ba ljang khu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ me ri 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wa na bid+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog nag po lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can phur bu dang tho ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bgegs lhag ma rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ rkang mthil gyi bar du phyung ste brlag par byas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dhahūṃ phaṭa/ de dag gi rnam par shes pa yi ge a'i rnam pas gnas pa la/ hūṃ zhes lan mang du bzlas pas/ ma rungs pa'i sems thams cad dang bral bar byas nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/

sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas de'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs te/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ shing brgyad dang*/ phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ zhing skyong brgyad dang*/ chu brgyad dang*/ me brgyad dang*/ ro dang ro langs dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ ma mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sha rus dang*/ bya dang*/ gcan zan dang*/ grub pa pho mo dang*/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas du mas gang ba'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i yi ge bh+ruṃ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin can yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ser/ nub dmar/ lho sngo ba/ de'i nang du las kyi snam bu rim pa lnga ste/ dang po zhi ba'i las snam dkar po/ de'i phyi rol rgyas pa'i las snam ser po/ de'i phyi ru sna tshogs pa'i las snam phyogs re rer g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ dkar ser ljang dmar sngo ba/ de'i phyi rol du dbang gi las snam dmar po/ de'i phyi ru drag po'i las snam nag po ste/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi gnas gzhan rnams su me tog sna tshogs la mngon par bkram zhing*/ drag po'i las snam la/ mtshon chas gtubs pa'i mi'i yan lag mngon par bkram pa/ dbus sngon po ut+pal dmar po sil mar gtong ba'i gzhi la/ rdo rje'i mu khyud zlum po'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing*/ ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ nang le tshe dgur gyur pa'i dbus dang sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/

dbus su zla ba/ sgo bzhir nyi ma/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ dkar po las byung ba'i zla ba nya gang ba la/ a ā i ī u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams kyis mtshan pa'o/ / de'i steng du āḥdamar po las byung ba'i nyi ma 'od 'bar ba la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥrnams kyis mtshan pa'o/ /nam mkha'i lha mo zla ba la thim/ zla ba'i dbus su tāṃ ljang sngon/ de las ut+pal sngon por gyur/ de thams cad las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ tāṃ la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma rnam 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ sku mdog sngo zhing yid tsam ljang ba/ pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na gri gug

/gsum pa na cang te'u/ bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na ka pā la khrag gis gang ba/ gsum pa na mdung rtse gsum/ bzhi pa na me tog gi gzhu 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du rdo rje kha ṭāṃ ga bsgreng pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgyas sku la brgyan cing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo rlon gyi 'phreng ba dang*/ ut+pal dmar po'i do shal 'phyang ba/ drag mo chen mo/ /spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing*/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings shing phyed grol ba/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ phyi rol tu me dpung 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /bshad rgyud las ni zhal lnga pa/ dbu skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs par bshad do/ / rang gi thugs ka nas swāhā dang*/ oṃ yig dang*/ ho yig dang*/ phaṭa yig dang*/ tāṃ laṃ/ taṃ maṃ/ tāṃ paṃ/ tāṃ hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa rnams phyir spros te gdan la 'khod pa ni/ le tshe brgyad la/ shar du swā hā/ las zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo ngang pa la zhon cing chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /byang du oṃ las rgyas pa'i sgrol ma ser mo glang po che la bzhon cing sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ cung zad sha nyams rgyas shing dgyes pa'i nyams can no/ /nub tu ho las dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo rta dmar po la bzhon pa me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa 'dzin pa chags pa'i nyams can no/ /lhor phaṭa las drag po'i sgrol ma nag mo ma he sngon po la bzhon cing rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/

g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa khros pa'i nyams can no/ /shar lhor tāṃ laṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ /lho nub tu tāṃ māṃ las rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ /nub byang du tāṃ pāṃ las chos kyi sgrol ma dmar mo/ /byang shar du tāṃ hūṃ las rdo rje'i sgrol ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi dang pos rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i ut+pal/ gnyis pas mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ khyad par gzhan ni gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu sgrol ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa sgrol ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor baṃ las lcags sgrog sgrol ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor hoḥlas dril bu sgrol ma ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang khro mo'i nyams can sbom zhing thung ba/ phyag g.yon thugs kar sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa/ stag lpags dang mgo 'phreng dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na mi ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /da ni pho nya mo rnams spro bar bya ste/ las bzhi'i sgrol ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis spros te las kyi snam bu dbus ma'i phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du 'khod pa ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan brgyad brjod/ maṃ hā laṃ kha hrīḥdza phaṭa phaṭa/ shar gyi g.yas na rmongs byed ma/ /lug la bzhon cing rtse gsum sbrul/ /g.yon na dug kun gzhil mdzad pa/ /mkha' lding la bzhon bum pa bsnams/ /gnyis car mdog dkar cung zad khro/ /byang gi g.yas na rengs byed ser/ /rus sbal la bzhon lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /g.yon na gnon byed khams ser ni/ /ri rab la bzhon ri rab 'dzin/ /gnyis ka'ang stobs ldan blun po'i gzugs/ /nub kyi g.yas na 'gugs byed ma/

/ha ri ṇa bzhon lcags kyu dang*/ /zhags pas bsgrub bya 'dren cing rgyug /g.yon na 'debs byed phur bu 'dzin/ /rab g.yo rlung la bzhon pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams/ /lho yi g.yas na skrod byed ma/ /dbyug to 'dzin cing rnga mong bzhon/ /g.yon na 'byed byed gri lcags sgrog /khwa dang 'ug pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gnyis ka'ang dud kha shin tu khros/ / yang 'byed byed ma srub shing 'dzin pa ma he dang rta la gnas pa bsgom pa'ang yod do/ /de nas phyag brnyan rnams spro ba ni/ gtso mo'i thugs ka nas hūṃ zhes spros te/ /nang gi gra bzhir 'khod pa ni/ /shar lhor gshin rje gshed po nag /zhal drug phyag drug zhabs kyang drug /g.yas rnams tho ba g.yon zhags pa/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug zhabs kyis mnan/ /lho nub mi g.yo mi g.yo ba/ /nag po ral gri thod pa 'dzin/ /brgya byin dbang ldan zhabs kyis mnan/ /nub byang rta mgrin sku mdog dmar/ /phyag bzhi dbyug to pad+ma dang*/ /'khor lo dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /dbu yi steng du rta mgo ljang*/ /klu dang yi dwags rgyal po mnan/ /byang shar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag/phyag bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu tho ba phur bu 'dzin/ /log 'dren 'dod lha zhabs kyis mnan/ /thams cad stobs chen pha rol gnon/ /sbom thung spyan gsum stag lpags dkris/ /sbrul gyis brgyan cing skra yang brdzes/ /me dpung 'bar zhing sprul pa dang*/ /yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la mig tu oṃ tā re swāhā dkar po/ rna bar oṃ tut+tā re swāhā sngon po/ lce la oṃ tu swāhā dmar po/ snying gar oṃ re swāhā sngon po/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swāhā ljang khu/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po sa'i snying po'i ngo bo/ rna bar dz+riṃ nag po phyag na rdo rje'i ngo bo/

snar khaṃ ser po nam mkha'i snying po'i ngo bo/ lcer gaṃ dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo/ dpral bar skaṃ ljang gu sgrib pa rnams sel gyi ngo bo/ lte bar saṃ sngon po kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i dbus su dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje rta'i rgyal po rab tu khros pa sku mdog sngo sangs/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal spyan gsum pa/ steng zhal rta gdong sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral gri dang*/ g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje/ mda' dang*/ gtun shing 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis thod pa/ gzhu dang*/ dgra sta bsnams pa/ stag lpags dang*/ dar dang*/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du lha dang lha min thams cad gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i ut+pal/ de'i steng du tāṃ yig ljang sngon 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ （《dzaṃ》+ ye shes pa ） rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun du spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang*/

spyan ma dang*/ mā ma ki dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams byung ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes chu dbang dang*/ oṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes cod pan dang*/ oṃ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hūṃ badz+ra a dhi pa tī s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dril bu dang*/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra satwā s+t+waṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes ming dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes brtul zhugs dang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /yid kyi las su brtan pa'i phyir/ / phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes de yan chad bum dbang dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma dang dpal don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khar byin par bsam/ oṃ aḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas gsang dbang dang*/ bdag nyid yab tu gyur pa la dbang gi lha mo de rnams gcig tu 'dus pa dam tshig sgrol mar gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la phyag rgyar gtad/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ dbang dgu yang dag par blang ba'o/ /dbang gi lha rnams rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par gyur te/ lha rnams kyi cod pan du bzhugs pa ni/ gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ 'khor thams cad la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'am/ mtshan nges par grags pas bstod de/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang*/ mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang*/ g.yo ba'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ma/ ye shes dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ （《dzaṃ》+ rdo rje cod pan lnga dang ldan pa/ ） 'byung ba rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen po/ shin tu phra ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/ sgra sgrog dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ba ma/ rnam par gshegs pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen

mo'o/ /de skad kyang bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ gi mthar/ yi ge bcu pas g.yas skor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ tā re tu re tut+tā re hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla ba ni sku'i bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ tā re swāhā/ zhes pa ni gsung gi bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ zhes pa ni thugs kyi bzlas pa'o/ / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wā lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ta/ pra duṣ+ta/ ma ma kṛ te/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha yaṃ/ ban+dha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+taṃ staṃ bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes pa ni las kyi sngags so/ / oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā re shān+tiṅku ru swāhā/ oṃ tā re puṣ+ting ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re wa sha ma nā ya hoḥ oṃ tā re ni wa rā ya phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta tā re laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na tā re māṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma tā re pāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tā re hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ aṅku sha twa re dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ pa sha tā re hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ shwiṃ kha la tā re baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ gaṇ+ḍe tā re hoḥhūṃ/ oṃ mo hā nī tā re maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pra sha ma ni tā re swāhā hūṃ/ oṃ staṃ bha ni tā re laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ dzam+bha ni tā re khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā kar+ṣa ni tā re hraḥhūṃ/ oṃ kī la ka tā re dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ ut+ya ḍā ka tā re phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ dwe ṣa ka tā re phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ni dhu ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya gṝ ba hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa mtshan sngags kyi 'phreng bar grags pa rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥkro dh+ye ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a tsa la kā na tseṭ+ṭa tseṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa ruṭ+ṭa ruṭ+ṭa gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad mān+ta kṝta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hūṃ/ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ na ma sa man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo mahā badz+re kro dha ya/ mahā raṃṣ+tot+ka ka ṭa bhi ṣa na bhai ra bā ya/ badz+ra san do ha dar+pā ya oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo bzhi'i rtsa sngags su grags pa rnams kyang bzla'o/ /de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dang po rjes su bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang ut+pal thogs pa brgyad spros te/ sems can rnams kyi 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug bskyabs par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ tā swāhā/ oṃ re swāhā/ oṃ tuta swāhā/ oṃ tā swāhā/ oṃ re swāhā/ oṃ tu swāhā/ oṃ re swāhā/ zhes bzlas par bya ste/ 'jigs pa las yongs su skyobs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /gnyis pa tshar bcad pa ni/ hūṃ ring po lan nyi shu rtsa lnga brjod pas/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad thugs rje chen pos bskul te shin tu ches khros shing 'khrugs par bsam/ der pho nya phyag brnyan bcu gnyis po rnams las/ sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo mtha' yas pa spros te/ ma rungs pa gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ na maḥsan+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ pho nya lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs kyi gtso bo bdud bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin thams cad bkug/hūṃ zhes brjod pas 'brub khung gru gsum pa zab cing yangs par gyur/ de'i nang du gnod byed thams cad kyi yan lag zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gis bsdams te/ phaṭa kyi sgras mgon skyabs dang bral bar byas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+taṃ kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces thugs ka nas phur bu'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ hūṃ gi sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ na mo （《dzaṃ》+ mahā ） badz+ra kro dha ya/ mahā daṃṣ+to ta ka ṭa （《dzaṃ》+ bhi ṣa ṇa ） bhe ra bā ya/ badz+ra san+do ha dar+pā ya/ oṃ a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+taṃ kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la bka' bsgos pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa spros/ gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyi dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang lte ba dang gsang ba dang tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang dbang po lnga la sogs pa rnams su phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs par bsams la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ta na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la ya/ sa ma ya dha rā ādzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan/ kā ya wa k+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum bzlas la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba duṣ+taṃ ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/

ces drag tu bzla/ oṃ stam+bha ya laṃ/ zhes 'brub khung gi kha laṃ las byung ba'i ri rab kyis bcad pas/ bskal pa'i bar du gdug pa'i sems can rnams thar pa med par bcings par bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ lha dang lha min cod pan sogs kyis bstod nas/ thams cad rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rang gi lus la thim/ rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i tāṃ la thim/ de yang cha lnga'i rim pas nā da la bsdus/ de yang stong pa nyid du thim par gyur/ āḥzhes brjod cing rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la gnas par gyur/ gzhan yang gzungs kyi sgo ci rigs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de las nges par ldang ba na/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gyur/ zhes lha'i skur bltas te thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug cing*/ gal te gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ sha khrag chang dang byi kyu la sogs pa'i gtor ma byas la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ de rnams kyi steng du a las ka pā la'i nang du/ dbus su hūṃ las sha chen dang rkang mar/ shar du oṃ las ba glang gi sha dang dri chen/ byang du hā las glang po che'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu hrīḥlas rta'i sha dang khu ba/ lhor aṃ las khyi'i sha dang rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su oṃ yig de'i steng du āḥlas zla phyed/ hūṃ las rdo rje oṃ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams zhu ste bdud rtsi dkar por gyur/ dri ma thams cad phyir lud āḥzhes brjod pas bdud rtsi dmar por gyur/ kha dog dang dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par byas/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi kha dog sna tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par spel zhing spros/ oṃ yig zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te bdud rtsi la thim/

zla phyed rdo rje oṃ yig dang bcas pa yang zhu zhing thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswāhā de nas/ phaiṃ gyi sgras/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa'am / sarba duṣ+taṃ sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañdza ka ma ma shīn+taṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes btags pas gtso mo dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ a pra ti ha ta shwa sa nāṃ/ he he bha ga ba te mahā satwa sarba bud+dha a ba lo ki te mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba e daṃ ba ling gṛ h+ṇa pā ya gṛ h+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba bi sañtsa re swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la phul la/ dur khrod gnas pa rnams la/ a bhi dha na'am/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las 'byung ba ltar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya'o/ / mchod bstod gsol btab yan lag bdun pa sogs rjes kyi bya ba dang bcas pa rnams bya'o/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ dri mas sems nyid mngon bsgom pas/ /rnam shes ye shes dag mi 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog gi bgrod pa'i gnas/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dngos po bden brdzun rnam dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong*/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /aḥzhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ hūṃ zhes bya ba ni ye shes dang ldan pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ phaṭa ces bya ba ni dgas par byed pa'i gzungs yi sgo'o/ /trāṃ zhes bya ba ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /a zhes bya ba ni smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ha zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /hrīḥzhes bya ba ni rjes su chags pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /oṃ zhes bya ba ni lus 'jig par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/

khaṃ zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /aṃ zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /k+ṣa zhes bya ba ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /āḥzhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ya zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i rlung ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i me ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /wa zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i chu ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /taṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sems te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /iṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i dbang po rnams te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /bi zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams su byad pa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /āḥzhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /rnam shes ye shes rnal 'byor te/ /de dag rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor la ni rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ / zhes gang gsungs pa de'o/ /des na lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa de yang gzungs kyi sgo la sogs pa sna tshogs pas rnam par dpyad nas/ spros pa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi stong pa nyid la 'jug pa ni lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su bsnan cing bsgom par bya ba yin pas rjes su rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ yang gsungs pa/ spre'u dang glog ltar mi gnas pa/ /rab tu gzung bar dka' ba'i sems/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa/ / ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /gser khams rdo la rnam gnas pa/ /mngon par zhi ba yod ma yin/ /sreg dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /nyi ma bzhin du rnam par gsal/ /lcags bzhin me la rnam bzod na/ /gzhan dag ci phyir mi bzod byed/ /'di yi ye shes rnam shes dag / cha gnyis rnam par rtog mi bya/ /cha gnyis las ni sdig pa 'byung*/ /sdig pas bsod nams zad par 'gyur/

/sdug bsngal sdig pa zhes brjod de/ /bla med bde ba bsod nams so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam gyur pa/ /bsod nams sdig med rnam par thar/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs te/ /dge dang sdig pa rnam par 'byed/ /bu mo'i longs spyod bde ba yis/ /rnam par mi rtog gnyis med 'grub/ /ri bo nyams ni dga' ba dang*/ /nags tshal dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan gzung*/ /dang por 'dus pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje cho gas rab tu bsgrub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /dam tshig chen mor byin gyis rlabs/ khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang*/ / de bzhin shin tu brkyang ba dang*/ khab dang gru mo'i mtshan nyid bya/ /bung ba lta bur i yi sgra/ /nges par blo dang ldan pas bskul/ /sgeg 'chos stabs kyis 'khyud nas ni/ /mgo bo'i skra bzung lkog ma gzir/ /ma mchus sbrang rtsi gzhib par bya/ / zhes sogs nas/ 'dar dang dran pa nyams pa dang*/ /skra grol gcer bu gsher bas khyab/ /mdog dmar rab tu phra ba'i mig /ye shes lnga yis rnam par sprul/ /bud med shes rab ye shes te/ /de las ye shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes sbyor ldan pa/ /sku yi rdo rje bsnyen par brjod/ /rlung ni mnyam par gyur pa dang*/ /sīd kyi sgra dang skad 'gyur ba/ /gsung ni nye bar bsgrub pa'o/ /bskyod pa las ni rab zhu ba/ /nor bur bcu drug cha babs te/ /yid kyi bde bas gnyis 'gags pa/ /thugs kyi de nyid sgrub par brjod/ /gzhu yi gzugs can rab sbyor bas/ /dung dang kun da ltar thig le/ /sdom brtson bde bas gzung bar bya/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes mchog /sgrub pa chen po'i de nyid de/ /rnam shes ye shes dag par byed/ /'di yis rdo rje'i bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes chen por rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor mkhas pas bstod/

/ ces pa'i bar du rgya cher gsungs te/ lha sku snang stong zab gsal gnyis su med pa de yang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'char ba zhig nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa ni/ snga ma gnyis kyi steng du bde ba chen po bsnan te rnal 'byor du byed pa'am/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes mchog la shin tu nye ba'i phyir/ shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'i sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor gyur pa ste/ rnal 'byor phyi ma gsum po 'di'i rnam par bzhag pa sogs go don ni/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa la brten te/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sgrub thabs bris pa las/ /bsod nams rgya chen gang thob pa/ /de yis slob dpon mchog dgyes shing*/ /'gro kun 'jigs las sgrol bar shog /sngon chad kha ba can na 'di med de/ /'phags yul bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa ni/ /bod yul 'gro la chos sbyin dri med de/ /thar pa 'dod rnams rgya cher dga' bar mdzod// // ces sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs ye shes 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ mi phrogs pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag dam pa'i dbang phyug dpal stag lung thang pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi zhal snga nas bka' stsal ba spyi bor nod de/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas kun ldan gyi lo chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la rnam rgyal rab brtan tu sbyar ba'o/ /slar yang ngag 'don bde bar bcos shing cho ga'i yan lag cung zad kha skong kyang byas pa'o/ / ma ṅga laṃ/ / bi sta re/ / zhus dag / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'bar ba bzhugs/
